title: Google launches Pics, an image creation and editing tool for Workspace
dek: Google says its new Pics tool, built on its latest Nano Banana model, is now available in Google Workspace.
socialCaption: Google has launched Pics, an image creation and editing tool for Workspace built on its Nano Banana model. The next questions for business users: where it integrates, what it can edit and what governance controls Google provides.
